propositions: Bare-repository fixture setup fails under Git's safe.bareRepository=explicit policy because commands use cwd-only or git -C routing that triggers implicit discovery rejection.
git config gc.autoDetach false and git symbolic-ref HEAD refs/heads/tickets commands in fixture helpers fail with exit 128 when the bare repository is not explicitly targeted via --git-dir.

Test fixtures for concurrency, prepare-reclaim, and reclaim-history inadvertently erase repository-kind intent by invoking generic worktree-oriented helpers on bare repositories without explicit repository selection.

Production code in infra/scripts/prepare_reclaim_backup.py::_verify_restore creates a temporary bare restore.git and routes fetch/rev-parse through a shared run_git helper that uses git -C, causing the same safe.bareRepository=explicit rejection.
Repair requires adding narrow --git-dir targeting to bare-specific fixture and script call sites without changing Git safety settings or worktree-oriented helper behavior.
